aggregate_to_query_conditions.status: Actual retained implementation now identified; common full static + selected semantic evidence
steps: onExecuteAsync routes dto.dmc through _createSearchRequestDto, else legacy shape conversion.
For data_type $$aggregate it configures condition=equal_condition and group=aggregate, with no sort mapper id set by this branch.

SearchModelDescriptor.toRequestDto executes registered Condition/Sort/Group callbacks from DMC metadata, resolves list property IDs, deduplicates group IDs, returns conditions/sorts/groups plus optional flow_condition.
Then _applySearchRequestNormalizers dispatches registered $$aggregate normalizeAggregateRequest and _mergeOptionSorts applies separate option_sort.
normalizeAggregateRequest gets the DMC aggregate value and resolved list prop; if a matching condition exists, replaces its value with buildNormalizedAggregate output; always rebuilds groups.
aggregate_to_query_conditions.unknown: Actual equal_condition / aggregate callback registrations are external and were not identified in inspected retained sources. Runtime DMC definitions/mappers/current page binding and server processing remain unknown.

free_aggregate_normalization.source: For type free, buildNormalizedAggregate removes only details_target and returns the remaining object. All retained condition_0N nested fields, including sort_type and show_subtotal if present, are preserved without local coercion/renumbering.
free_aggregate_normalization.boundary: Preservation inside a condition value is not proof that request.sorts is populated or a server uses a given field.

fixed_details_conversion.source: For non-free with details_target, filter props with truthy prop_id, slice to external EN_CONDITION_KEYS.length, and create condition objects in those external key slots. Created fields use sort_type=A and show_subtotal=false. With no details_target, return aggregate_key/comparison_period only.
fixed_details_conversion.boundary: These fixed-mode defaults must not replace free selector show_subtotal=true. EN_CONDITION_KEYS definition is not present in these2 bodies.

group_membership.source: rebuildAggregateGroups returns [] for fixed+details_target.value=line. Otherwise it loops external EN_CONDITION_KEYS, skips absent/falsy prop_id and duplicate identical prop_id, and emits {prop_id} only. It does not inspect show_subtotal or sort_type.
group_membership.implication: In this client normalizer, a selected axis remains a group when show_subtotal=false; direction/subtotal do not become fields on group descriptors. This does not prove backend group formulas or arbitrary duplicate input acceptance.

request_sorts_boundary.source: The $$aggregate branch does not define a sort mapper. Its normalizer replaces condition.value and result.groups but does not modify result.sorts. Separate options get converted and merged, with option entries winning by identical prop_id and final priority order.
request_sorts_boundary.unknown: No direct condition_NN.sort_type -> request.sorts mapper implementation identified. Do not claim that axis direction is ignored: it remains nested in the free aggregate condition value and server interpretation is unknown.

show_subtotal_to_grid_config.source: buildSummarySort enumerates getAggregateConditionKeys and maps each selected condition to consecutive sort_seq, sort_prop=prop_id, subtot_tf=show_subtotal. This synthetic sort hard-codes asc_desc=A. createSummaryConfig passes it to getGroupAggregateConfigs; free grid$aggregate_dlt_feature_config stores returned config as feature_configs.data_generator.summary_config.
show_subtotal_to_grid_config.guards: getGroupAggregateConfigs skips missing group section DMC/prop/datatype, numeric sort props, configured Count grouping in aggregate modes, and resolveDateUnit Skip. Eligible config carries subtot_tf unchanged plus dynamically resolved accumulators/title metadata.
show_subtotal_to_grid_config.boundary: This is a local grid/DLT configuration consumer. It does not reveal the original server measure/tax/rounding formulas or show final generated rows without the external generator/current dynamic definitions. Synthetic asc_desc=A is not evidence that request direction is always A.
show_subtotal_to_grid_config.override: Separate grid$ui_sort_dlt_feature_config [27596,2,27621,2] may replace subtotal_config and delete existing summary_config. Current runtime override state is unobserved.
